email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

Our patient, a male in their 50s with hypertension, was given DemoCardolol, at a dose of 50mg, (fourth dose).
Treatment started on 2026-07-26.
About 8 days later, they developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Duval (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter660@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
